explanation: Leonardo of Pisa, later nicknamed Fibonacci, used it in his 1202 book Liber Abaci to count breeding rabbits. Indian scholars had described the same numbers centuries earlier.

claims.text: The sequence in which each number is the sum of the two before it is named after Fibonacci, Leonardo of Pisa.
The sequence is not named after Pascal, Euler or Pythagoras.
Leonardo of Pisa presented the sequence in his book Liber Abaci of 1202, through a puzzle about breeding rabbits.
The nickname Fibonacci was given to Leonardo of Pisa after his lifetime.
Indian scholars described the same sequence centuries before Leonardo of Pisa.
